founder_storm_receipt.text: 19P — Active catch, soft rain. Rain artwork and rain-cloud artwork overlay the field; this is visually distinct from clear/breezy play. - GOOD, this obstacle makes the puddles! The puddle creates inertia that the basket must get through to avoid bad fruits/catch good ones. It should be animated in a slight moving fashion like how puddles are but it should use my art entirely. Should use rain obstacle audio, and should have something [a popup with contact large card - sized perfectly] with strawberry saying “uh oh! a little storm is passing. o__o”

entries.description: Implement wind movement in code rather than relying solely on animated artwork.
entries.conditions_and_implementation_evidence: Actual physics adds bounded wind force to fruit/star trajectories at each controller frame, independently of decorative animation.
entries.remaining_acceptance: Apple actual visual motion, audio and device frame timing.

entries.description: Use the existing wind artwork as the visual reference.
entries.conditions_and_implementation_evidence: Breezy field renders original fruitbasket_wind PNG with preserved aspect/directional presentation; actual resource decoded and checksum recorded, not replaced/generated. Same logical wind direction drives physics and reference art.
entries.remaining_acceptance: Apple actual bundle/art registration and visual match.

entries.description: Make wind alter fruit trajectories slightly.
entries.conditions_and_implementation_evidence: Actual frame tests verify left/right small position changes, no hidden wind in clear/rain controls, while captured base fall speed/drift remain unchanged; force is clamped and lane bounded.
entries.remaining_acceptance: Apple play feel and trajectory/visual acceptance.

entries.conditions_and_implementation_evidence: Existing wind presentation invokes registered fruitBasketWind cue; sound remains owned by central AudioManager settings/lifecycle, not a duplicate player. Actual original gust MP3 resource is present; audible execution not inferred.
entries.remaining_acceptance: Apple actual cue timing, mute/lifecycle and audible gust acceptance.

entries.description: Use existing rain and rain-cloud artwork for soft rain.
entries.conditions_and_implementation_evidence: Soft-rain presentation uses original rain and rain-cloud PNGs, aspect-respecting sizing/low opacity and hit-test exclusion. Both actual original PNGs decode successfully with hash/dimension receipts.
entries.remaining_acceptance: Apple bundled image loading and distinct clear/breezy/rain presentation.

entries.conditions_and_implementation_evidence: Every soft-rain engine round inserts painted puddle obstacle and removes hidden wind; actual rainy controller fixture loads the real mask and exhibits ground contact.
entries.remaining_acceptance: Apple rendered rainy field with matching painted puddle.

entries.description: Animate puddles subtly while preserving the original artwork.
entries.conditions_and_implementation_evidence: Existing original puddle PNG is used unchanged; only subtle1.012/0.993 scale and1.2pt drift at2.8s animate when active and not Reduce Motion. Pause/reduced motion/disappear settle it without animations. Resource/mask hash match verified.
entries.remaining_acceptance: Apple subtle animation/Reduce Motion/pause visual acceptance; Foundation tests cannot execute SwiftUI repeat animation.

entries.description: Display Strawberry’s specified storm popup using the existing large contact-card artwork.
entries.conditions_and_implementation_evidence: Storm screen uses actual shared FruitfolioLargeControlCardPopup, original control_large_card art and Strawberry. Shared geometry defines bounded writing aperture and scrollable content, both dismiss controls and escape share ownership-guarded handler. Serious context removes decorative character per global serious rules.
entries.remaining_acceptance: Existing real testStormModalOwnsFocusBoundaryAndOneCloseAcrossAllDismissalHandlers is NOT_RUN; Apple card size/character/focus/actual controls acceptance.

entries.conditions_and_implementation_evidence: Ordinary storm heading preserves exact founder line1537 dialogue: uh oh! a little storm is passing. o__o. Serious-sensitive context uses existing calm alternative, and o__o is protected during translation. No founder replacement copy invented.
entries.remaining_acceptance: Apple visible dialogue and protected localization, existing actual storm UI regression NOT_RUN.

entries.description: Add basket inertia while the basket physically passes through a puddle.
entries.conditions_and_implementation_evidence: Actual portrait and landscape controller moves basket through original painted puddle, encounters resistance monotonically, reaches target and preserves earned counters/backing storage. Swept collision prevents jumping across water between drag callbacks.
entries.remaining_acceptance: Apple actual gesture/inertia feel on physical device.

entries.conditions_and_implementation_evidence: Basket resistance drives existing code-rendered tilt/translation and ground-state accessibility explanation; reserved header shows contact guidance without resizing playfield during contact. Actual contact/response inputs are exercised; believable pixels are pending.
entries.remaining_acceptance: Apple visible resistance, translation/VoiceOver and motion acceptance.

entries.description: Restore normal movement after leaving the puddle.
entries.conditions_and_implementation_evidence: Actual basket leaves painted region and next dry movement responds immediately with zero resistance/contact; no residual slow state or credit/storage mutation.
entries.remaining_acceptance: Apple gesture restoration and visible dry response.

entries.description: Position branch obstacles as though growing from the screen edge.
entries.conditions_and_implementation_evidence: Renderer and collider share alpha-footprint geometry; original branch mirrored so thick root reaches right playfield edge. Actual sparse painted mask tests verify edge intersection and absence on left.
entries.remaining_acceptance: Apple visual root registration against original art.

entries.description: Make fruit bounce off branches and change trajectory.
entries.conditions_and_implementation_evidence: Actual controller/painted physics provide one bounded upward bounce followed by persistent horizontal deflection, without mutating captured base speed/drift.

entries.description: Make vines slow good fruit passing through them.
entries.conditions_and_implementation_evidence: Only actual good fruit crossing original painted vines is slowed to0.56 base fall rate, contact time progresses and first-entry sequence emits once; invisible middle field does not slow.
Standalone star uses same painted-vine slowing/contact semantics as good fruit, including actual controller frame test and original mask.
entries.remaining_acceptance: Apple standalone star visual struggle/return to free fall.

entries.description: Prevent bad fruit from using the vine-slowing interaction.
entries.conditions_and_implementation_evidence: Bad fruit is explicitly excluded from vine state/slow factor, preserves free-fall behavior and never emits eligible contact entry. Actual good/star/bad comparison executes all three together.
entries.remaining_acceptance: Apple visual distinction between affected and excluded objects.

entries.description: Play rustling audio when appropriate objects contact vines.
entries.conditions_and_implementation_evidence: Actual first-contact physics returns eligibility once per entry; controller increments vineContactSequence and existing onChange handler calls registered vineRustle only on increase. No per-frame replay while remaining in leaves.

entries.description: Make vine resistance visibly believable rather than merely changing an invisible velocity value.
entries.conditions_and_implementation_evidence: Both original fruit and star views render contact-driven slight stretch/periodic struggle rotation while true painted-contact flag is set; Reduce Motion disables struggle but preserves slowed physics and accessible classification alternative. This is implementation review, not believable visual verification.
entries.remaining_acceptance: Apple subjective believable resistance and Reduce Motion acceptance.
